free_text: Systematic investigation of channel-coupling effects
on elastic, inelastic, and neutron-transfer channels
in 6Li+159Tb
Homi Bhabha National Institute, Mumbai
14UD BARC-TIFR Pelletron-Linac
A self-supporting target of 159Tb foil having a
thickness ~700 ug/cm2
Four silicon surface barrier
detector telescope with different thicknesses: T1
with delta E=25 um and E=500 um T2 with delta E=25 um
and E=2000 um T3 with delta E=25 um and E=3000 um T4
with delta E=25 um and E=2000 um were employed in an
angular range 20-160 degree.
The Si surface barrier detectors used in the experiment
have an estimated energy resolution of ~150 keV.
Two monitor detectors at fixed angles of
+/-10 degree with respect to beam direction for
normalization purpose.
Errors in the fit parameters and statistical
data errors were included in the overall error
calculation for both elastic and inelastic components.
Data received from S.Bhattacharjee
